_comment: The file share: which directories are exported and who may connect. The Samba page edits this; scripts/render_all renders it into smb.conf. Passwords are NOT here — they live only in Samba's own credential store, set from the panel — so after restoring this file from a backup every user shows 'no password yet' until one is set again.
_comment_shares: Each share exports one directory. valid_users empty means every configured user may use it; list names to restrict it. is_read_only true refuses writing for everyone.
_comment_users: Accounts that may connect, by name. Applying creates each as a system account with no shell and no login, in the sambashare group. Removing one here revokes its credential and group membership on the next apply, but never deletes the unix account.
